text:
jana: FYI - executive memo final: we're updating overage policy for burst traffic and clarifying invoice granularity. This is mostly policy cleanup but customers need clear expectations.

rico: outline?

jana: key points: (1) Overage charges for on-demand accounts will apply only after a 48-hour invoice grace window, (2) Burst forgiveness: first 3 spikes/month are waived unless they're sustained >1 hour, (3) Invoices will show CU by model family and include a 'peak usage' snapshot.

billing-bot: Note: grace window enforcement requires new billing job config. Finance will run a dry-run report for the last 3 months to estimate impact.

paula: Will partners on marketplace be affected?

jana: Marketplace vendors will be under partner agreements; we'll coordinate policy language. No sudden cuts.

legal: Add refund flow for accidental overages and require support tickets within 30 days to request reversal.

rico: Ops: can we add a webhook for high-peak alerts for partner accounts?

infra-bot: created ticket INF-9123. webhook endpoint will be available in staging in 10 days.

paula: Customer comms plan: email + Console banner + in-product modal for first-time overage hits. Also include a 'how to cap spend' quickstart for integrators.

jana: rollout: policy doc internal review by end of week, public doc + FAQ 2 weeks after, billing code freeze 3 weeks, enforcement in production in 6 weeks.

billing-bot: Automated conversion credits for legacy customers will be calculated using the 30-day avg CU burn and applied as a one-time invoice credit. No retro billing.

jana: assign: @rico - webhook spec; @paula - comms drafts; @legal - refund T&Cs; @infra - implement dry-run report. escalate to #exec-ops with any blockers. :white_check_mark:
